name: VAICOM Community Edition
summary: Free voice-control add-on for VoiceAttack that operates DCS radio and AI communication menus by speech.
description: VAICOM lets you issue DCS comms commands (ATC, wingmen, AWACS, AIRIO, etc.) by voice instead of the comms menu; the community edition is 100% free. It is a separate program (MSI or zip) that runs as a VoiceAttack plugin.

releases.changelog: OKB Out reliability and AID connection, AH-64D George commands, TX-Link rework, F-14 AIRIO improvements.
